about: Evaluation set for the knowledge engine (roadmap Stage 9.6). Each question is asked through the same code the kb_lookup and kb_patch tools use, against the live sources. A question passes when one cited fact holds every string in `expect` (exact wording from the source); `from` and `game` pin the source and the game; `claim` questions must get the stated verdict; `none` questions must return nothing presented as a fact. The expected strings were read from the sources on the `checked` date. Run with: npm run test:kb
